summaries.title: MMLU-Pro: A More Robust and Challenging Multi-Task Language Understanding Benchmark
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **MMLU-Pro** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖思维链（Chain-of-Thought (CoT)），并引入 Massive
Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：This paper introduces MMLU-Pro, an enhanced dataset designed to extend the mostly knowledge-driven MMLU benchmark by integrating more challenging, reasoning-focused questions...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **MMLU-Pro, MMLU**。实验设计与验证细节：This paper introduces MMLU-Pro, an enhanced dataset designed to extend the mostly knowledge-driven MMLU benchmark by integrating more challenging, reasoning-focused...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **16%, 33%, -5%, 2%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our experimental results show that MMLU-Pro not only raises the challenge, causing a significant drop in accuracy...；With 24 different prompt styles tested, the sensitivity of model scores to prompt variations decreased from 4-5%...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 54 赞），本工作可作为评估 **思维链与树搜索 (CoT & Search)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Show, Don't Tell: Aligning Language Models with Demonstrated Feedback
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Show, Don't Tell** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)），并引入 Demonstration
ITerated Task Optimization (DITTO) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：Steering LLMs away from generic output is possible through supervised finetuning or RLHF, but requires prohibitively large datasets for new ad-hoc tasks。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We argue that it is instead possible to align an LLM to a specific setting by leveraging a very small number (<10) of demonstrations as feedback。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **19%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Across our benchmarks and user study, we find that win-rates for DITTO outperform few-shot prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and other self-play methods by an average of 19% points）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 33 赞），本工作为突破 **监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)、人类反馈与偏好优化 (RLHF/DPO)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Despite its widespread success among humans, the capacity for artificial learning agents to accumulate culture remains under-explored。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Building on the previously demonstrated ability for reinforcement learning agents to perform social learning, we...；These accumulating agents outperform those trained for a single lifetime with the same cumulative experience）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 14 赞），本工作为突破 **训练与强化学习** 中的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **25×**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Moreover, muLOs demonstrate better generalization than their SP counterparts to deeper networks and to much longer training horizons (25× longer) than those seen during meta-training）。
